**Finding: INSURANCE — missing (redline proposed).**

The Agreement has no insurance provision anywhere. I checked the full outline and both substantive sections: Sections 1–9 (HDI responsibilities, Company responsibilities, fees, term/termination payment, site management, exclusivity, cross-promotions, confidentiality, warranties) and General Provisions 10.1–10.8 (notices, no joint venture, assignment, waiver, governing law, severability, survival, entire agreement, headings). Targeted searches for insurance/coverage/certificate terms returned nothing.

HDI hosts the Site and, under Section 8.1, has access to Content, user information and data of the Company — a vendor that touches our data with no insurance is walk-away territory under the playbook.

Cure: a single inserted Section 10.9 at the preferred level — CGL $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate, E&O $2M, cyber and privacy $5M where HDI processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company, workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. No survival tail, expense or procedural extras were added beyond the checklist elements; the fallback (E&O $1M / cyber $2M) is flagged in the comment as a negotiating position.
